display.purpose: Hero and landing headlines only. Confident, not shouting.

title.purpose: Card titles, subsection heads, dialog titles.

body.purpose: All prose and UI copy. Cap prose at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Buttons, form labels, badges, nav, metadata.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Quiet default for white product cards.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Slight lift on hover to signal interactivity.

shadows.name: clay
shadows.purpose: Signature molded block. Marketing/hero surfaces only, paired with 24px radius.

shadows.name: clay-amber
shadows.purpose: Clay tinted with amber, for amber-role hero elements.

shadows.name: clay-blue
shadows.purpose: Clay tinted with blue, for blue-role hero elements.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default exponential ease-out for state transitions. No bounce, no elastic.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Standard transition for hover/focus/active in product UI (150-250ms band).

motion.name: slide-up
motion.purpose: Entrance for revealed content. Must have a reduced-motion crossfade fallback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main call-to-action per screen. Crossing Amber fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F37321; color: #fff; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C97E0A; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #F37321; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The common, non-terminal action. Bridge Blue fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #378ADD; color: #fff; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #1E4F8A; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #378ADD; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. Blue border, fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #378ADD; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; padding: 12px 24px; border: 2px solid #378ADD; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #378ADD; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #378ADD; }

components.name: Standard Card
components.description: Default white content card. Flat at rest, lifts on hover.
components.html:
Digital Marketing Mastery

4 weeks - EN / Pidgin - Learn to grow any business online.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E0DDD5; border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-card:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); } .ds-card-title { font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; color: #2C2C2A; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.6; color: #5A5A58; margin: 0; }

components.name: Clay Card
components.description: Signature claymorphic card for marketing/hero surfaces. Rationed, not default.
components.css: .ds-clay-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.6); border-radius: 24px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 8px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.10), 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.07); transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-clay-card:hover { transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-clay-title { font-family: Poppins, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.5rem; color: #2C2C2A; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard form field. White fill, warm hairline border, blue focus ring.
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #2C2C2A; margin-bottom: 6px; } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #2C2C2A; border: 1px solid #D5D2C8; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9A9A97; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #378ADD; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Pill badge for course category / status. Tinted bg + darker text in a role color.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: Nunito, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-amber { background: #FDE7D6; color: #C97E0A; } .ds-badge-blue { background: #EBF4FF; color: #1E4F8A; }

narrative.overview: SkillBridge is a structural blue framework laid over warm, grounded terrain - the system that connects ambitious Nigerians to opportunity. Blue is the bridge: dependable, load-bearing. Cream is the ground it spans: warm, human, unpretentious. Amber is the traffic that crosses it: the one hot color reserved for the single most important action on any screen. The system reads as confident and distinctly Nigerian - proud and forward-looking, never a global-edtech template and never an aid-org brochure. It is product-first, serving teachers, youth, and employers on low-end Android over 2G, where restraint is the discipline and the tool should disappear into the task.
keyCharacteristics: Warm cream ground, structural blue, single amber accent - a committed, legible 60/30/10 split.
One palette, one identity. No competing indigo. No rainbow-per-category cards in the app.
Tactile, confident components: rounded, chunky, satisfying - friendly weight without childishness.
Bandwidth is a design constraint: lean, fast, offline-friendly, WCAG AA.
Claymorphism as a signature spice, not the main dish.

rules.name: The Single Crossing Rule
rules.body: Amber (#F37321) is the only hot color and appears on at most one primary action per screen. Two ambers competing for the eye means neither wins.

rules.name: The One-Ground Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one palette: cream / blue / amber / ink. The legacy indigo edu-* tokens are retired and must not appear in new work.

rules.name: The Two-Face Rule
rules.body: Poppins heads, Nunito reads. Never swap them, never introduce a third family.

rules.name: The Rationed Clay Rule
rules.body: Claymorphism is spice, not the meal. It belongs on marketing heroes and moments of delight; product surfaces stay flat-to-shadow-sm.

rules.name: The No-Glass Rule
rules.body: Glassmorphism is effectively banned as decoration. Reach for a solid surface instead.

dos: Do keep the 60/30/10 rhythm: ~60% Warm Cream ground, ~30% Bridge Blue structure, ~10% Crossing Amber action.
Do reserve amber (#F37321) for the single primary action on a screen.
Do set headings in Poppins, body in Nunito, and nothing else.
Do keep product surfaces flat-to-shadow-sm; ration claymorphism to marketing and delight moments.
Do verify muted text: Ink Mid (#5A5A58) is the floor for body-sized secondary text on cream.
Do give every interactive element visible focus, hover, disabled, and where relevant loading/error states.
Do design for 2G first: display=swap fonts, lazy/optimized images, minimal JS, skeletons over spinners.
donts: Don't use the retired indigo edu-* palette (#4F46E5, #818CF8, #1E1B4B, #EEF2FF).
Don't ship a rainbow of per-category card colors in the product app.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text); use a single solid color and emphasize with weight or size.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right stripe as an accent.
Don't look like navy-and-white SaaS, or like an aid-org 'charity for Africa' brochure.
Don't animate for spectacle; motion conveys state (150-250ms) and always has a prefers-reduced-motion path.
